Body.Content:
Updated November 6, 2026: We have updated the timeline. Thank you for your patience. 

What and why

We are adding the ability to duplicate an event in Microsoft Outlook. From the event details, users can select Duplicate event to quickly create a new event based on an existing event without re-entering the same details.

Rollout schedule

  • General Availability (Worldwide, GCC, GCC High): Rollout began in late September 2026 and is expected to complete by early December 2026 (previously late October).

Impact on your organization

Who is affected

  • Users who create events in Microsoft Outlook

Platforms and services

  • Microsoft Outlook

What will happen

  • A new Duplicate event option will appear in Microsoft Outlook event details.
  • Users can quickly create a new event based on an existing event without re-entering the same details.

Action required and recommendations

No action is required.

Compliance considerations

No compliance considerations identified. Review as appropriate for your organization.
